scope: Read-only serialized source audit against pre-M7 HEAD; no Unity, model, lobby or live process launched.

network_prefab.note: New Social behaviours and regenerated NGO prefab hash are intentional game0.8 network-contract changes; client/server builds must match. No claim that the full prefab is byte-identical.

physics_migration.note: Serialization5→11 migration renames velocity/bounce threshold, adds explicit defaults and moves editor gizmo settings. Existing numeric/solver/matrix fields match; source comparison is not a replacement for live physics/prediction regression.

player_settings.note: All other text changes are trailing whitespace. Root owns restoring preloadedAssets and whitespace; game version bump is intentional.

preserved_sources.baseline_comparison: Materialized image SHA256 and length exactly match baseline Git LFS pointer, not pointer text bytes.

limitations: New social movement gates are mode-specific; Sandbox CanMove returns true. Their actual integration is verified separately in a live Sandbox run.
